name: Exp_XWAMI_MMRec
summary: This EA is based on the XWAMI indicator for signal generation combined with a money management recommendation module. It opens buy/sell positions when the XWAMI indicator signals overbought/oversold conditions, using the MMRec module for dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XWAMI指标产生交易信号，并结合资金管理推荐模块(MMRec)进行仓位控制。当XWAMI指标发出超买或超卖信号时，EA自动开仓做多或做空，并通过MMRec模块根据账户权益和风险参数动态调整仓位大小。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于XWAMI指标的均值回归原理，该指标融合了WAMI（加权动量指标）的变体来识别市场的超买超卖区域。入场条件为：当XWAMI指标从超卖区上穿信号线时做多，从超买区下穿信号线时做空。出场条件包括反向信号出现时平仓、止损触发或止盈达到预设目标。仓位管理通过MMRec模块实现，该模块根据账户可用保证金、预设风险百分比和止损距离自动计算最优手数。资金管理方面，EA采用了基于固定比例风险的仓位计算方法，每次交易的风险金额占总权益的固定比例。整体策略属于系统化的均值回归交易，依赖指标反转信号捕捉价格回归均值的机会。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the mean reversion principle of the XWAMI indicator, which is a variant of the WAMI (Weighted Momentum Indicator) designed to identify overbought and oversold market conditions. Entry conditions: the EA opens a long position when the XWAMI indicator crosses above its signal line from the oversold zone, and opens a short position when it crosses below from the overbought zone. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signal generation, stop-loss trigger, or take-profit reaching the predefined target level. Position sizing is managed through the MMRec (Money Management Recommendation) module, which automatically calculates the optimal lot size based on account free margin, predefined risk percentage, and stop-loss distance in points. The money management approach uses a fixed-fractional risk model where each trade risks a consistent percentage of total account equity. Overall, the strategy is a systematic mean reversion system that relies on indicator reversal signals to capture opportunities when prices revert to their mean.

parameters.name: MoneyRisk
parameters.description: 每笔交易风险占总资金比例
parameters.description_en: Risk per trade as percentage of total balance

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, typically set at gap close

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (used when MMRec disabled)

parameters.name: MM_Enabled
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理推荐模块

pros: 采用固定比例风险模型，每笔交易风险可控，避免单笔过大亏损
MMRec模块根据账户权益动态调整仓位，实现自适应资金管理
基于均值回归策略，在震荡行情中有较好的表现潜力
XWAMI指标融合加权动量，信号质量优于简单RSI指标
pros_en: Fixed-fractional risk model ensures each trade has controllable risk, preventing oversized single-trade losses
MMRec module dynamically adjusts position size based on account equity, enabling adaptive money management
Mean reversion strategy has good potential in ranging/choppy market conditions
XWAMI indicator incorporates weighted momentum, offering better signal quality than simple RSI indicators
cons: 均值回归策略在趋势行情中容易连续亏损，缺乏趋势过滤机制
未见明显的新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺乏点差过滤，在低流动性时段点差扩大可能导致不必要的止损触发
未明确是否有持仓检查，可能存在重复开仓的风险
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy tends to produce consecutive losses in trending markets, lacking a trend filter mechanism
No visible new bar check mechanism, which may lead to repeated position opening on the same bar
No spread filter, which can cause unnecessary stop-loss triggers during low-liquidity sessions with widened spreads
No explicit position check, posing a risk of duplicate position opening
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如长期均线方向判断），避免在强趋势行情中逆势交易
添加新K线检查机制和持仓数量检查，防止同根K线重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., long-term moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend trading in strong trending markets
Implement new bar check and open position count verification to prevent duplicate entries on the same bar

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查可能导致同根K线多次开仓
无点差过滤在高点差时段可能增加交易成本和止损风险
均值回归策略在单边行情中存在连续亏损风险
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may cause multiple position openings on the same bar
No spread filter increases trading costs and stop-loss risk during high-spread periods
Mean reversion strategy carries risk of consecutive losses during strong directional markets
